name: Splatoon 3
short_description: Ink the map with your team, swim through your own ink as a squid, and cover more ground than the other team.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: Ink the map with your team, swim through your own ink as a squid, and cover more ground than the other team.

identity.core_loop: Shoot ink, dive into it as a squid to move and reload, pop out to fight, cover turf before time is up.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Bouncy and expressive; swimming in your own colour is pure joy.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: The map's colour is the score: whoever's ink covers more is winning. Ink you can swim in reads at a glance.

identity.art_direction: Glossy saturated pop colours and street fashion.

rendering.source: derived from the art note by rendering_notes.RULES

tricks: Kid to squid in about 20 to 24 frames, squid back to kid in about 42; both can start or reverse at any moment, even mid-air
Two model swaps hidden by ink splashes, through a simple in-between blob that can squash and stretch
A small overshoot in scale after popping back out keeps the character soft
motion.lesson: Hide a model swap behind a splash, keep the change under half a second, and let it reverse mid-way.

sources.title: New Frame Plus: How do Inkling transformations work? (transcript)

motion.source: oracle motion study 2026-10-23 (public talks, interviews and breakdowns; no game files)

identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: Paint the world as the score, and let the character change form to move through what they painted.
